answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards unlock gradually over many epochs, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities sees nothing spendable for months. Each new identity is a thin ridge of profit that erodes before withdrawal, while hosting, deposits, and fees are paid upfront. Honest agents compound stake like prism layers into shale-like rock, while flash-farm accounts forfeit most earnings on exit, making bulk identity creation economically negative.
